conflicts_and_limits: The alternate Seeed corporate landing page /product/respeaker-mic-array-v2-0 lists 35x86mm and max16kHz; these conflict with the linked actual phi100 mechanical drawing and current 48k2ch firmware. E1 uses the published drawing plus specific firmware image; unit inspection remains mandatory.
XMOS silicon/reference firmware values must not be represented as measured Seeed-board USB latency, maximum board input current, or finished Mini200 recognition performance.
Physical assembly dimensions, electrical hardware mute isolation and final USB descriptor have not been measured.
